http/server#

An HTTP server: a listener, a handler and a policy.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

object Hello does Handling {
    Hello();

    async handling(request is Request, context is HttpRequestContext) is HandlingResult {
        ResponseHandling(Response(status: Status.ok, content: TextBody(text: "hello")));
    }
}

let listener = await TcpListening(port: 8080).listener();
let server = HttpServer(listener: listener, handling: Hello()).started();
…
await server.drain(limit: Duration(seconds: 5));

Description#

An HTTP server: a listener, a handler and a policy.

The server speaks HTTP/1.1 under ServerPolicy() unless told otherwise; with tls: it speaks HTTPS and offers its protocols by ALPN, h2 first. With url: it also takes WebSocket upgrades, whose Origin must match that URL. started() serves in the background; drain() stops accepting, lets requests in flight finish within the limit and closes. Applications usually build on web/server, which adds routing, replies and middleware.

HttpServer.HttpServer#

HttpServer(listener is TcpListener, handling is Handling, tls is TlsServerPolicy, policy is ServerPolicy = ServerPolicy(), clock is Timing = SystemClock())

HTTPS (#209): HttpServer(listener:, handling:, tls: TlsServerPolicy(identity: identity)). A policy of both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 offers both by ALPN.

HttpServer.HttpServer#

HttpServer(listener is TcpListener, handling is Handling, url is UrlParts, tls is TlsServerPolicy, policy is ServerPolicy = ServerPolicy(), clock is Timing = SystemClock())

HTTPS with its own https: URL, which WebSocket upgrades are checked against.

HttpServer.HttpServer#

HttpServer(listener is TcpListener, handling is Handling, url is UrlParts, policy is ServerPolicy = ServerPolicy(), clock is Timing = SystemClock())

With url:, the server's own URL, it also accepts WebSocket upgrades: the Origin of an upgrade is checked against it.

Errors#

  • BadRequest: a request the server answered with 400 itself.
  • HttpServerBodyTimedOut: a request body paused longer than the policy allows.
